name: cw-payroll-social
description: Curacao payroll for employers, tax year 2026. Covers who withholds and who is an employee, wage tax (loonbelasting) from the 2026 six-band table and period tables, the 2026 credits on the Loonbelastingverklaring, the AOV/AWW, AVBZ and BVZ premiums from the SVB 2026 table with their ceilings, the employer-only ZV, OV and cessantia, the monthly return due by the 15th with the 2026 dates, penalties, the verzamelloonstaat and Article 45 cards, Lei di Bion, the ex-patriate regime, customary salary for directors and foreign artists. Trigger phrases include Curacao payroll, loonbelasting Curacao, AOV premium, BVZ, SVB Curacao, Lei di Bion, verzamelloonstaat.
